I1.title: Token remains valid after reset
I1.issue_text: After resetting my password I still get 'Invalid token' until I log out. Password reset should properly invalidate or revoke previous tokens.

I2.title: Total calculation issue with extreme values
I2.issue_text: A 100% discount makes the invoice total negative when discounts exceed the total amount.
